use std::path::Path;

#[test]
fn recovery_entry_authority_is_compiler_sealed() {
    let directory = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .join("tests/worth_store_court_recovery_runtime_replication/sources/worth_store_recovery_runtime/ui")
        .canonicalize()
        .expect("recovery authority fixture directory");
    for name in [
        "admitted_cannot_skip_discovery",
        "bare_witness_cannot_enter",
        "checkpoint_binding_basis_has_no_unfunded_constructor",
        "checkpoint_binding_decode_requires_native_window",
        "cleanup_cancellation_cannot_be_forged",
        "cleanup_cancellation_cannot_be_reused",
        "cleanup_close_cannot_be_forged",
        "cleanup_close_cannot_be_reused",
        "cleanup_eligibility_cannot_be_forged",
        "cleanup_eligibility_cannot_be_reused",
        "cleanup_fresh_reopen_cannot_be_reused",
        "cleanup_freshness_rejects_caller_source_and_policy",
        "cleanup_performed_evidence_cannot_be_forged",
        "cleanup_removal_is_not_a_media_method",
        "discovered_cannot_skip_planning",
        "discovered_recovery_cannot_clone",
        "fresh_reopen_action_cannot_be_substituted",
        "freshness_port_cannot_be_constructed",
        "freshness_port_rejects_raw_session",
        "freshness_sample_and_member_cannot_clone",
        "freshness_sample_rejects_caller_generation",
        "funded_observation_cannot_duplicate_or_extract_present_bytes",
        "manifest_entry_budget_is_built_only_by_the_walk_entry",
        "manifest_entry_charge_cannot_be_forged",
        "manifest_entry_charge_cannot_be_reused",
        "manifest_entry_charge_has_no_zero_units",
        "manifest_entry_view_is_not_a_charge",
        "ordinary_backend_qualification_is_not_a_recovery_dependency",
        "performed_recovery_effect_cannot_be_forged",
        "platform_authority_cannot_clone",
        "raw_checkpoint_cannot_be_cloned_or_adopted",
        "recovered_handoff_cannot_be_forged",
        "recovery_attempt_is_not_performed_evidence",
        "recovery_cannot_ask_an_owners_allowance",
        "recovery_construction_authority_cannot_be_forged",
        "recovery_construction_port_cannot_be_forged",
        "recovery_construction_requires_cleanup_close",
        "recovery_effect_actions_cannot_be_substituted",
        "recovery_effect_cannot_be_recorded_before_execution",
        "recovery_limit_cannot_be_minted_by_a_caller",
        "recovery_limit_failure_is_not_a_struct_literal",
        "recovery_limits_are_not_struct_literals",
        "recovery_limits_cannot_be_minted_outside_their_owner",
        "recovery_wal_segment_cannot_be_forged",
        "registered_session_cannot_admit_two_coordinators",
        "reopened_recovery_cannot_be_forged",
        "request_rejects_c7_handoff",
        "request_rejects_live_store",
        "selected_recovery_cannot_be_forged",
        "session_cannot_terminate_twice",
        "source_read_allocation_prevents_coordination_disposal",
        "unregistered_freshness_cannot_admit_coordination",
        "wal_observation_cannot_clone",
        "wal_read_diagnostic_cannot_escape_backing",
        "wal_selection_cannot_deep_clone",
    ] {
        worth_testkit_compiler::denied(directory.join(format!("{name}.rs")))
            .expect("prebuilt compiler denial");
    }
    for (source, kind) in [
        ("namespace_durable_recovery_cannot_be_forged", "NamespaceDurablePhysicalRecovery"),
        ("planned_recovery_cannot_be_forged", "PlannedPhysicalRecovery"),
        ("staged_recovery_cannot_be_forged", "StagedPhysicalRecovery"),
    ] {
        worth_testkit_compiler::certification_uncoded_semantic_denial(
            directory.join(format!("{source}.rs")),
            "cannot construct",
            &[kind, "private fields"],
        )
        .expect("private recovery authority cannot be forged");
    }
}
